messages:
maria: Quick check-in — marketing needs a short changelog excerpt, canonical docs links, and a benchmark line for the Friday release announcement. Were also promoting a webinar. Can engineering/docs confirm items by 3pm PT? @sam @jess @priya

sam: Got it. Draft changelog snippet below (marketing-friendly):
```
- Adaptive batching enabled in v2 runtime (major throughput gains on long sequences)
- Optional KV cache persistence for Private installs (faster warmups)
- Region-aware routing + safer canary flags for gradual rollouts
```

jess: Docs canonical URLs use these exact links in the post and CTAs:
- https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2.0/changelog
- https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/private-deploy
- https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/v2-methods

priya: Rollout plan: canary begins 15:00 PT Friday, staged ramp ~90 minutes to 100%. We will NOT auto-upgrade Dedicated/SLA clusters; opt-in only. Monitoring hooks will post status to #eng-releases.

maria: Good — marketing will say: "Rolling out Friday at 15:00 PT with a ~90-minute ramp; Dedicated customers are opt-in." Also need webinar RSVP link and presenter names for the post. Who will present?

sam: I can present the live demo + take Qs. Suggest Priya joins for the roadmap/ops Q&A. I'll add a short benchmark slide showing customer-facing numbers.

jess: Benchmark blurb suggestion: "Internal tests show up to ~3x throughput on long-context workloads vs v1; see methodology in benchmarks doc." Link above.

maria: Perfect. Webinar RSVP: https://events.redwood.ai/webinars/v2-launch — use that as the CTA. We'll embargo blog/social until rollout start time. Legal ok?

priya: Legal/compliance cleared earlier today, no embargo exceptions.

maria: Great. Final checklist for EOD: sam to confirm demo script, jess to ensure changelog & docs pages are live at those URLs, priya to confirm deploy bot schedule and monitoring alerts. I'll assemble the announcement copy and post for final sign-off by 5pm PT.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: release/v2 at 2025-06-06T22:00:00Z (15:00 PT). Will emit status updates to #eng-releases during canary and ramp.

sam: Will be online for last checks and the webinar prep.

jess: I'll update the docs pages now and ping when URLs are confirmed live.

maria: Thanks team I'll circulate the draft shortly :rocket:
